page_title: LEN 3-4 HAV | Lens v Le Havre 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
90+4' Here comes a substitution. Josue Casimir is given a rest as he is replaced by Timothee Pembele (Le Havre).
90+2' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rayan Fofana (Lens) replacing Adrien Thomasson.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 38167.
90+1' 3 - 4 Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) sends Mathew Ryan the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
90+1' Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The Le Havre players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

89' Play continues despite the shouts by some Le Havre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
88' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Le Havre for a penalty. Play continues.
87' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) steps up to send the ball in.
87' Florian Sotoca (Lens) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Lens will take a corner kick.
85' Lens couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
84' Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. Lens are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
82' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
79' Ruben Aguilar comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tom Pouilly (Lens).
79' Here is a change. Wesley Said is going off and Will Still gives the last tactical orders to Goduine Koyalipou (Lens).
78' Wesley Said (Lens) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
76' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities. Ball possession – 68:32.
74' Here comes a substitution. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Andre Ayew.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) will replace Abdoulaye Toure.
71' Will Still has decided to substitute Anass Zaroury and he is replaced by Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
70' Neil El Aynaoui is being substituted because of an injury. Will Still sends Andy Diouf (Lens) on the pitch.
68' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Wesley Said (Lens) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
65' Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
64' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick. That's a free kick to Lens.
62' 3 - 3 Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is the first to get to a rebound inside the penalty area and his weak, but precise effort finds its way into the back of the net, bouncing in off the crossbar.
62' A player from Lens commits a rough challenge. Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
59' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is caught offside!
58' A pass from Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is intercepted by Mathieu Gorgelin and the move breaks down.
54' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul after Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) hacks down one of his opponents.
53' Anass Zaroury (Lens) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
52' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
50' Dangerous play by Malang Sarr (Lens). Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

48' 3 - 2 Deiver Machado produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Florian Sotoca (Lens) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 3:2.
48' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
47' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+8' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
45+7' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
45+5' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+4' Wesley Said (Lens) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
45+3' Neat passing move from Lens in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lens due to an offside in the build-up play.
43' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Lens players aren’t happy.
42' Goal! Wesley Said (Lens) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 3:2.
41' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
39' Anass Zaroury (Lens) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
39' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Lens have a corner.
35' The current number of shots on goal is 4:2.
34' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
33' 2 - 2 Goal! Issa Soumare finds Andre Ayew (Le Havre) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 2:2.
30' Lens work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
30' Facundo Medina (Lens) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
30' Anass Zaroury (Lens) takes the corner with a short pass.
28' 2 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Issa Soumare (Le Havre). He perfectly collected a pass from Andre Ayew and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the right post. The score is 2:1.
25' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
24' The game is interrupted now, Issa Soumare (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' A pass by Deiver Machado (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
23' Lens quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
22' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.

19' 2 - 0 Goal! A terrific long pass from Deiver Machado picks out an unmarked Ruben Aguilar (Lens) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
18' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' The linesman signals that Wesley Said (Lens) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
14' Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre).
10' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
9' Anass Zaroury (Lens) will take a corner kick.
9' Deiver Machado (Lens) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.
8' One of the players from Le Havre times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
5' Facundo Medina (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
3' 1 - 0 Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) gave the goalkeeper no chance from the penalty. Mathieu Gorgelin failed to reach the ball, which slid off the crossbar into the roof of the net.
2' Neil El Aynaoui is going to take the penalty!
1' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jeremie Pignard signals. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Lens.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lens will kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
